Package org.lightsleep.entity

Annotation Interface ColumnTypeProperty

@Documented @Retention(RUNTIME) @Repeatable(ColumnTypeProperties.class) @Target(TYPE) public @interface ColumnTypeProperty
Indicates the column type related to the field defined in superclass.

This annotation is used to specify for fields defined in superclass. The specified contents also affects subclasses, but specifications in the subclass takes precedence. If you specify type=Void.class or type=Void (Groovy), the specification in the superclass is canceled.

Java Example
 @ColumnTypeProperty(property="birthday" type=Long.class)
  public class Person extends PersonBase {
Groovy Example
 @ColumnTypeProperty(property='birthday' type=Long)
  class Person extends PersonBase {
Generated SQL
 INSERT INTO ... (..., birthday, ...) VALUES (..., 1486210201099, ...)
